title: certAI
tagline: certAI is a global trust layer for DApps that delivers safe, verifiable DApps to the world.
description: certAI is a decentralized verification platform that builds trust in Web3 by certifying dApps through a seamless flow of AI audits, human validation, and certificate issuance. Developers submit their dApps, which are first analyzed by an AI engine powered by the Artificial Superintelligence Alliance (ASI) to generate detailed security reports. These reports are then reviewed by human validators, who confirm or reject the findings while earning incentives for their contributions. Once approved, certAI issues a digital certificate containing the audit and validation details, permanently stored on Filecoin/IPFS for transparency and immutability. Verified dApps are also assigned a unique ENS subdomain (e.g., appname.certAI.eth) that serves as a visible trust badge, allowing users to instantly recognize and interact confidently with certified applications. In this way, certAI empowers developers with credibility, protects users from malicious dApps, and rewards validators for safeguarding the ecosystem.
how_its_made:
certAI combines AI, blockchain, decentralized storage, and identity systems into one verification platform:
- Smart Contracts (Solidity) – Manage dApp submissions, verification states (approved/revoked), validator roles, incentives, and issuance of certificates.
- AI Engine (ASI-powered) – Automatically analyzes smart contracts and dApp behavior, generating audit reports with risk and trust scores.
- Human Validators – Review AI reports, contribute expertise, and record decisions on-chain while earning rewards for maintaining trust.
- Digital Certificates – Once verified, a certificate is generated containing the AI audit, validator approvals, and metadata. These are stored permanently on Filecoin/IPFS for transparency and immutability.
- ENS Integration – Certified dApps receive a unique ENS subdomain (e.g., appname.certAI.eth) as a visible trust badge for end users.
- Backend (Node.js + Express) – Orchestrates communication between smart contracts, AI audits, IPFS storage, and the frontend.
- Frontend Dashboard (React) – Provides an intuitive interface for developers to submit dApps, users to check certification, and validators to review reports.
